lines.zh: 缓慢爬行，发出低沉的咕噜声。
lines.en: Slowly crawls, making a low rumbly sound.

lines.zh: 在淤泥中爬行，偶尔挥动大钳。
lines.en: Crawls through the muck, occasionally waving its large claws.

lines.zh: 寻找水洼，发出求救的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Scans for puddles, making a distress hiss.

lines.zh: 爬行至食物，发出轻微咔嚓声。
lines.en: Approaches food, making a soft crunching sound.

lines.zh: 在水中游动，发出咕噜咕噜声。
lines.en: Swims in water, making a gurgling sound.

lines.zh: 沿着河岸缓慢前行，偶尔摆动触手。
lines.en: Creeps along the riverbank, occasionally waving its tentacles.

lines.zh: 在水草中寻找猎物，发出轻微嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Scouring for prey in the water plants, making a faint hiss.

lines.zh: 慢慢游动，偶尔咬住小鱼。
lines.en: Slowly swimming, occasionally biting small fish.

lines.zh: 在石缝中觅食，发出轻微的响声。
lines.en: Feeds in the cracks, making a soft noise.

lines.zh: 在水中缓慢移动，偶尔敲击触须。
lines.en: Moves slowly in water, occasionally tapping its feelers.

lines.zh: 用十只步足在浅水里划行。
lines.en: I row through the shallows on ten walking legs.

lines.zh: 尾针扫过水底，搅起泥沙。
lines.en: My tail spike sweeps the bottom and stirs the silt.

lines.zh: 爬出水洼，壳上挂着水藻。
lines.en: I crawl from the pool with algae on my shell.
I prowl along the marsh's edge.

lines.zh: 半睁着眼睛，静静等待猎物。
lines.en: Half-closed eyes, quietly waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 静止不动，等待猎物靠近。
lines.en: Staying still, waiting for prey to approach.

lines.zh: 静静地呆在水中，观察着周围。
lines.en: Quietly staying in the water, observing its surroundings.

lines.zh: 在水中漂浮，偶尔摆动触手。
lines.en: Floating in the water, occasionally waving its tentacles.

lines.zh: 在淤泥中静止不动，等待猎物。
lines.en: Staying still in the mud, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 在水中漂浮，偶尔移动触须。
lines.en: Floating in the water, occasionally moving its feelers.

lines.zh: 静静地在水中漂浮，等待猎物。
lines.en: Quietly floating in the water, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 静静地呆在水中，等待猎物。
lines.en: Quietly staying in the water, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 在水中漂浮，偶尔摆动触须。
lines.en: Floating in the water, occasionally moving its feelers.

lines.zh: 把身体埋进泥里，只露双眼。
lines.en: I bury myself in mud with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，眼睛猛然睁开。
lines.en: Notices the player, eyes suddenly open wide.

lines.zh: 看到玩家，发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Sees the player, makes a low hiss.

lines.zh: 凝视玩家，发出微弱的咕噜声。
lines.en: Stares at the player, makes a faint rumbly sound.
Wide eyes fixed on the player.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，发出警觉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Notices the player, makes an alert hiss.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Staring at the player, makes a faint hiss.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出低沉的咕噜声。
lines.en: Staring at the player, makes a low rumbly sound.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，发出微弱的咕噜声。
lines.en: Staring at the player, makes a faint rumbly sound.
My compound eyes turn to you, pincers parting.

lines.zh: 从水底抬头，盯住你的脚。
lines.en: I lift my head from the water and fix on your feet.
Shell cracked!
Moving hurts!
Ink seeps, hurting!

lines.zh: 情绪一低，我就想钻进沙里。
lines.en: When my mood dips, I want to burrow in sand.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂开，蓝血滴进泥里。
lines.en: My shell cracks and blue blood drips into the mud.
Attacked, hurts!
Wound infected, hurts!
Injured, hide!
Scabbed, no longer hurts!
Slow now, injured!
I'm hungry, come feed me!
Do you have my favorite food?
Your footsteps entice me.
Food! Food!
Come here! There's food!
Don't go, I'm not full.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉味压过了泥腥。
lines.en: The meat in your hand overpowers the reek of mud.

lines.zh: 泥底的腐肉不够，我要现成的。
lines.en: Carrion in the mud is not enough; I want fresh meat.
Do you have what I like?
The taste of food is so good.
I'll knock you away!
Hit your tough shell!
Let's have a contest!

lines.zh: 我在泥里爬，钳子先碰到你。
lines.en: I crawl through the mud; my claw reaches you first.
Push you out of my way!
Be careful of my impact!
I'll push you back!
How long can you hold out?
Use my horn to hit you!
Show you my power!
In the shallows, it is a good time to find a mate.

lines.zh: 我的螯足已经举起来求偶。
lines.en: My claws are raised in courtship display.
My season has come!
The tide fell; time to find a mate.
Let's go reproduce together!
Find your kind!

lines.zh: 潮水退下去，该找伴产卵了。
lines.en: The tide is ebbing; time to find a mate and spawn.
Let's lay eggs together!
My breeding season has arrived!

lines.zh: 泥岸上留下我的气味，等同类。
lines.en: I leave my scent on the mudbank for a mate.
Feeler senses prey!
Reach out from stone!

lines.zh: 这具贝壳下面，我抢到就吃。
lines.en: Under this shell, whatever I grab I eat.
Seize the moment!
Food nearby!
Swim through rocks!
Clamp down on prey!
Feed on flesh!
Rock sanctuary!
Seek shelter in stone!
Player enters domain!
Something small by the water is coming near.
Notice player!

lines.zh: 浅水的震动把你暴露了。
lines.en: The tremor in the shallows gave you away.
Victim’s scent! — 巨笔石鲎, target acquire
Player threat!
My mood is foul. Do not come close.
Victim in water!

lines.zh: 浅水里，我的触肢先探路。
lines.en: In the shallows my feelers go first.
The water ripples. You came.
My feelers catch your vibration.
You are at the edge of my pool.
Such a large piece of prey.
I am starving, and here you are.
Behind the weeds, I have you in sight.

lines.zh: 这块湿地归我，你不该来。
lines.en: This marsh is mine. You should not be here.

lines.zh: 泥水一浑，你就看不见我了。
lines.en: One stir of the mud and you lose sight of me.
Prey in shadows!
Attack time!
Victim’s end!
Stone concealment!
Victim devoured!
Victim struggles!

lines.zh: 螯肢张到最大，等你靠近。
lines.en: My chelicerae gape wide as I wait for you to come closer.
Victim trapped!
Victim surrounded!

lines.zh: 我贴近泥底，向你挪过去。
lines.en: I hug the muddy bottom and creep toward you.
My pincers open and close, waiting for a chance.
When you look down, I strike.
The shallows make me faster.

lines.zh: 往回退，你已经在水里了。
lines.en: Back away; you are already in the water.
My tail spike is raised.

lines.zh: 你踩起的泥雾挡住了眼。
lines.en: The mud you kicked up blinds you.

lines.zh: 我的螯足一绕，就到你的侧面。
lines.en: My chelicerae swing around to your flank.

lines.zh: 这一步，我要夹住你的腿。
lines.en: This lunge, I take your leg.
Fleeing onto land will not save you.
Snap! It swings its claws!
It wields its massive claws!
Its legs lunge forward!

lines.zh: 巨笔石鲎的螯狠狠一夹！
lines.en: Megalograptus's claws clamp down!
It attacks your abdomen with its claws!
It tries to grab you!
Megalograptus swings its big claws!
It attacks you with its sharp claws!
Its claws swing at you!

lines.zh: 巨笔石鲎挥动它的大螯！
lines.en: Megalograptus swings its big claws!
My pincers clamp your ankle.
My tail spike stabs your calf.
I throw my whole body onto your leg.
My pincers tear away a strip of skin.
I ram your knee with my shell.
I drag you toward deeper water.
Silt blinds your eyes.
Ten legs claw at you and hold fast.
I bite your finger and will not let go.
One snap, and your bones creak.
Habitat right, it hatches!
It hatches from an egg!

lines.zh: 幼体破卵而出，弱小但凶猛！
lines.en: Young hatchling breaks free, small but fierce!
It hatches from the water!
It hatches in the mire!

lines.zh: 它破卵而出，开始了新生活！
lines.en: It hatches and begins its life!
It hatches in the darkness!
Young hatchling, full of energy!
It hatches from the muck!
It hatches in the swamp!
The eggshell splits, and it slides into the shallows.
A small eurypterid wriggles out of the wet mud.

lines.zh: 培育器亮起，它在水里舒展。
lines.en: The incubator glows, and it unfolds in the water.

lines.zh: 复活的胚胎睁开了复眼。
lines.en: The revived embryo opens its compound eyes.
Flame burns!
Fell, injured!
Drowned, hurt!
Exploded, hurts!
Shot, hurt!
Cursed, hurts!
Hungry, weak!
Lightning hit, hurts!
Void, injured badly!
